decisions.reason: As a recent line extension in the firm's core coolant-management business, it should be kept because market uncertainty is still high after only one year and the cost of preserving this option is likely modest for a large established machinery supplier.
This centrifuge fits the firm's established filtration and process-media portfolio, so with no negative market signal yet and favorable industry conditions it is rational to keep the option open.

Because coolant nozzles build directly on the existing offer and can likely be supported through current sales and service channels at low incremental cost, the product should remain on the market while demand becomes clearer.

As a close adjacency to the firm's conveyor and automation activities, this chip conveyor should be retained since the launch is still recent and there is not yet enough evidence to justify abandonment.

This product strengthens the firm's established chip-handling portfolio and, in a growing industry with broad customer needs, keeping it preserves upside while little has been revealed so far about its full value.

Given its close fit with the firm's existing conveying solutions and the absence of poor results or clear cannibalization evidence, maintaining the product is the better real-options decision at this stage.
